question: What is the nature of the path after the attainment of the self?
premises: From the attainment of the self onward, one becomes inclined toward that reality.
This orientation applies in every action to be done.
The path is awareness, all action, and the qualities of seeing and doing.
inference: After self-attainment, the path integrates awareness and action in every deed through the powers of knowing and doing.
plain_english: From the attainment of the self onward, in every action to be done, the path is inclined toward that reality; it consists of awareness, consists of all action, and has the qualities of seeing and doing.
